title: Session outline
description: Output of LLM call 2 (outline). Consumed by call 3 (draft) and by the TTS/mix pipeline. Carries no timestamps by design - see transitions and beats.silence_plan.

template.description: Six templates carry fifteen categories. SPEC.md 1.5

sensitivity_flag.description: When true the intro variant carries explicit stop permission and generation is template-bounded. SPEC.md 8

exclusions.description: Three tiers with different lifetimes. SPEC.md 2.3.1

standing.description: Profile-level, persists until the user changes it

session.description: This session only. MUST NOT be written back to profile.

slots.description: Filled per docs/templates/slots.md. Shape varies by template.

transitions.description: Semantic markers only. Resolved to real timestamps after TTS returns character timings - the model never estimates elapsed time. SPEC.md 6.1

role.description: difficulty_and_response was renamed from obstacle_and_recovery: the old name presumed failure and forced a miss into sessions where the user asked for none. threshold/competence/the_moment/what_returns/continuation belong to Re-entry, where the feared moment is deliberately NOT the climax - continuation must outlast it.

cached_ref.description: Required when source is cached. Points into the 18-recording intro matrix.

word_target.description: Independent of silence_total_s. Word count per beat ranged 51-141 in reference session 01 and is NOT proportional to duration - deriving one from the other produces the wrong pacing.

wpm.description: Delivery rate belongs to the beat, not the session. 85-110 ordinary guidance, 65-90 scene-building. The setup and the difficult beat are exactly where a session-level rate mis-paces things.

silence_total_s.description: Must equal the sum of silence_plan[].seconds. Silence is content, not leftover gaps - it carried 43% of runtime in reference session 01.

silence_plan.description: Typed, because a 5s sensory pause and an 11s post-climax hold are different instruments.

type.description: sensory 3-6s | transition 6-12s | open 15-30s | hold: after a climax or an anchor, unbounded

beats_on.description: Slot keys this beat must use. Guides the draft stage without prescribing prose.

do_not_mention.description: Exclusions repeated INTO the beat context. A session-level header drifts by beat 6 - the constraint has to be present where the model would otherwise reach for it.

Cached beats have no access to user exclusions, so they may introduce NO concrete imagery at all - only the body and the breath. A water simile in a cached intro would breach a standing water exclusion the recording cannot know about.

ambience.description: Atmosphere-level only. Soundscape was descoped from scene-synced cinematic design: unevidenced, expensive, and it must keep working when the listener's imagined scene differs from the script - which by design it always will. SPEC.md 6.2.1

oneOf.description: Explicit silence. Required for climax beats - a stem system that always has something playing would ruin them.

level.description: Always quieter than the voice. No unexpected peaks.

stem_tag.description: Fixed enum. The model selects; it never invents a stem name that does not exist in the library.

description.description: Semantic, e.g. 'leaving the treeline, wind rises'. NOT a timestamp.

cached_ref.description: Sensitivity-flagged sessions MUST use the sensitive intro variant - it is the only one carrying explicit stop permission.
